title: matayba arborescens
intro: Matayba arborescens, commonly known as Palo de Viche, is a plant species that belongs to the Sapindaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various folk medicine practices, particularly in the Amazon region, due to its reported health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Matayba arborescens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help in relieving congestion and promoting the removal of mucus from the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
